shots.title: Drawn SVG map
shots.caption: Real OpenStreetMap geometry — midways, water, buildings, and every coaster's track — not map tiles.
shots.alt: Daylight Kings Island map drawn as SVG with coaster tracks, district names, and place markers

shots.title: Night map
shots.caption: Low-glare palette for after dark. Follows the phone until you pick one.
shots.alt: Night-theme Kings Island map with the same SVG geometry in a low-glare palette

shots.title: Tap a coaster
shots.caption: The ride's own track lights up. Callout: name, walk time, height rule.
shots.alt: The Beast selected on the map with its track highlighted and a place callout showing walk time

shots.title: Height requirements
shots.caption: One slider. Rides that are out today turn alarm red — ringed and struck through.
shots.alt: Kings Island map with rides below a 46 inch height filter marked in alarm red

shots.title: Walking directions
shots.caption: Turn-by-turn on the phone from the venue file. No routing API, no key.
shots.alt: Walking route preview on the Kings Island map with time, arrival, and path drawn

shots.title: Live party
shots.caption: Range, bearing, and walking time for each person — hosted on a phone in the group.
shots.alt: Party map with two member markers and a glance rail showing walking times

videos.title: Capability walkthrough
videos.caption: Drawn map, tap-to-highlight a coaster, height filter, walking directions, and a live party — Kings Island.
